s1: Fancy Plugs. Fourteen free effects for the whole mix.
s2: Every one of them works the same way. Presets, A and B, undo, and any value you can type. Learn one window, and you know them all.
s3: Dynamics. Comp puts its threshold right on the input meter. Multi Comp splits a mix into as many as eight bands. Gate closes a drum mic between hits. Limit holds a master under a true-peak ceiling. D S softens harsh esses, and D S Mini does it with one knob.
s4: Tone. E Q gives you up to twenty-four bands, and Match moves a track toward a reference. F I R turns down a ringing resonance, only while it rings. Exciter adds brightness. Sature adds tape or tube colour. Kicker puts a clean sub under a kick.
s5: Space. Delay builds up to sixteen taps, in time with the song. Verb comes with thirty-two impulse responses, in true stereo. Room goes from a small room to a long hall.
s7: Free to download for Windows, with Mac in beta.
